accessibility.text:
- document:
  - img "Blue gradient effect"
  - img "Red gradient effect"
  - text: Have more questions? Talk to support
  - button "Button"
  - img "No Account Holo"
  - heading "No Active Subscription" [level=1]
  - paragraph: "Email you logged in: [temporary research email]"
  - button "Sign out"
  - text: Check Subscription
  - button "Button"
  - link "Get subscription":
    - /url: https://tryholo.ai/pricing
  - paragraph: I bought a subscription, but it says "No subscription found." when logging in.
  - paragraph: "That can mean a few things:"
  - paragraph
  - list:
    - listitem: You purchased with one email but are trying to log in with another. (This often happens when using Apple Pay or Google Pay, which might use a different email.)
    - listitem: You may have entered a typo in your email address when purchasing.
    - listitem: You're using a capital/small letter variation - our system recognizes the exact email format, so it must match perfectly.
  - paragraph
  - paragraph: 💡 Check your inbox for a confirmation email or receipt - that's always sent to the purchase email.
  - paragraph: I haven't received a confirmation email after purchasing. Is this normal?
  - paragraph: No - confirmation emails are sent automatically to your purchase email, and your payment provider sends a second receipt that can't land in spam.
  - paragraph
  - paragraph: If you didn't get either, it likely means the email was mistyped during checkout.
  - paragraph: Can I log in with a password or another method?
  - paragraph: Not yet - for now, you can log in only using a 6-digit email code or Google authentication. Password login will be added in a future update.
  - paragraph: I'm receiving the 6-digit code, but it says "No subscription found."
  - paragraph: This happens because the code works with any email, but you must log in with the exact same email you used to purchase. We're already working on a fix for this issue - thanks for your patience!
  - paragraph: I'm not sure which email I used to sign up. How can I find out?
  - paragraph: "We can help! Just send us:"
  - paragraph
  - list:
    - listitem: The approximate time of your purchase
    - listitem: The last 4 digits of your card
  - paragraph
  - paragraph: We'll confirm which email your subscription is under.
  - paragraph
  - paragraph: You can also check yourself - if you didn't receive a confirmation or receipt, it likely means there was a typo in the email you entered.
  - paragraph: I made a mistake when entering my email. Can I change it?
  - paragraph: "No worries - just email us at support@tryholo.ai and let us know:"
  - paragraph
  - list:
    - listitem: The incorrect email you used
    - listitem: The correct one you'd like to update it to
  - paragraph
  - paragraph: We'll update it as soon as possible. It's a priority request, but please allow up to 24 hours during high-volume times.
  - link "Terms & Conditions":
    - /url: https://tryholo.ai/policies/terms-of-service
  - link "Privacy Policy":
    - /url: https://tryholo.ai/policies/privacy
  - region "Notifications alt+T"
  - alert
